messages:
maria (AE): Customer signed MSA. They want a POC + committed reservation for ~100k qps-month (peak ~5k RPS). Need: reserved GPU recommendation, burst policy, preheat/runbook, and a short pricing band fp16 vs 4-bit quant. Also security: customer-managed KMS + 13mo logs.
caleb (sales_eng): noted. They also stressed p99 token latency target 200ms and ~40% chat traffic with ~2k token context.
anya (solutions): Recommend start: 6 reserved GPUs (A100-80 equiv) with burst credits to allow +50% (up to 9). AZ split 3/3. KV-cache warmup typically reduces token compute ~25-35% for sessioned chat.
tom (infra): Preheat runbook (short): T-120m start kv-warmup; T-90m run synthetic @50% for 30m; T-60m run synthetic @75% for 45m (validate p99); T-0 enable burst credits for initial 4h. Autoscale example: scale_up if gpu_util>70% for 30s -> +1 GPU; scale_down if gpu_util<30% for 5m -> -1 GPU. Smoke cmds: ./kv-warmup --sessions 1200; ./loadgen --rps 3750 --ctx 2000 --dur 45m.
caleb (sales_eng): pricing ask: ballpark low/med/high for 6-GPU baseline fp16 vs 4-bit quant?
anya (solutions): ballpark: fp16 ~ "$72k/mo" for 6 GPUs. 4-bit quant + batching -> ~40-50% lower -> "$36k-$44k/mo". Burst billed at marginal premium (~+10%). I'll post a formal calc.
legal-liaison: Dedicated with customer-managed KMS + audit forwarding satisfies 13mo logs/SOC2 ask; Private required only for on-prem/air-gap. We should add model-licensing clause if they bring third-party quant models. Also can offer a conditional SLO: "P99 200ms while preheat runbook is executed as specified; otherwise best-effort." I'll draft wording.
maria (AE): Need final numbers for AE deck + quote by EOD. Caleb/Anya/Tom: please attach calc, autoscale JSON snippet, and the preheat checklist in this thread. Ping when done. :white_check_mark:
